item.title: Learning MLOps with a Feature Store: A New Series
item.description: I am teaching myself MLOps with Jim Dowling’s Building Machine Learning Systems with a Feature Store. This series follows that work: I rebuild the book’s hands-on projects with open-source tools, running on my laptop.
